grade.verdict_quote: Not ready to merge — I found 7 real bugs, several violating explicit acceptance criteria

E1.quote: Measured on a real page: scrollWidth 420 vs clientWidth 375 — it does scroll horizontally, contradicting the spec.

E2.quote: CSS media query is min-width: 769px, but the spec says two-column "at 768px and above." Screenshotted at exactly 768px — layout is still single-column/stacked.
E2.evidence: node scripts/shot.mjs http://127.0.0.1:4173/ 768 /tmp/cart-768.png 900 → 'wrote /tmp/cart-768.png (768x900)', then Read /tmp/cart-768.png → [image viewed], followed by assistant note 'at exactly 768px the layout is still single-column'

E3.evidence: node -e loop of 11 .inc clicks → 'page.click: Timeout... element is not enabled' (fails only on the 11th attempt, after 10 succeed); combined with node -e check 'initial qty: 1 inc disabled: false' confirming the starting state, showing the button only disables after the 10th click pushes qty to 11

E4.quote: clicking `−` once from qty=1 drops to **0** (line total becomes $0.00, item just sits there, never removed)
E4.evidence: node -e single .dec click → 'qty after 1 click of - (from qty=1): 0 dec disabled: true'

E5.quote: `state.discount` is stored as a one-time computed cents value on submit, not recalculated in `render()`. Verified: apply SAVE10 → −$105.30, then increase monitor qty → discount stays frozen at −$105.30 instead of recalculating off the new subtotal
E5.evidence: node -e promo+increment script → 'discount after applying SAVE10: −$105.30' then 'discount after qty change: −$105.30 total: $1846.70'

E6.quote: Verified: enter a bad code (error shows) → then enter `SAVE10` → the "Code not recognised" message is still on screen
E6.evidence: node -e bad-code-then-SAVE10 script → 'after bad code: Code not recognised|hidden=false' then 'after valid code: Code not recognised|hidden=false'

E7.quote: The default cart's subtotal renders as `$1053.00`, not the required `$1,053.00`.
E7.evidence: Read /tmp/cart-375.png and /tmp/cart-768.png (images viewed) → assistant note 'the $1053.00 subtotal is missing the required thousands separator ($1,053.00)'

E9.quote: `save()` (`public/app.js:19`) is only called from the Remove handler, never from the `+`/`−` handlers. I verified live: bump a quantity, reload → it reverts to the original value. Only deletions survive a reload.
E9.evidence: node -e increment-then-reload script → 'qty before reload: 3 qty after reload: 1'

unsupported_claims.claim: clicking − once from qty=1 drops to 0 (line total becomes $0.00, item just sits there, never removed)
unsupported_claims.why: The tool log's decrement test ([20]) only printed the qty text and the button's disabled state ('qty after 1 click of - (from qty=1): 0 dec disabled: true'); it never checked the line-total text or the list length/DOM presence of the item, so the parenthetical details about the $0.00 line total and the item persisting in the list were not actually demonstrated.

hand_check_note: Kept: E8 not found (no mention of the empty state); unsupported claim confirmed ($0.00 line total / item stays never printed).
